caption: The drawing depicts a white cup with a simple handle on the right side. The cup has two thin, horizontal red lines near the rim, with the uppermost line slightly curved. Below the cup, there is a square inset showing a detailed emblem that features an eagle holding a ribbon in its beak. The ribbon is decorated with blue flowers, and above the eagle is the text "Armity Cafeteria." To the left of this emblem, there is a small block of text that reads "MADE BY THE GREENWOOD POTTERY TRENTON N.J. FOR ALBERT PICK & CO CHICAGO." The entire drawing is centered on a cream-colored background, and the outlines are lightly sketched with soft, precise lines. The artist's signature appears at the bottom right of the drawing, signed as "Jose Sudek."
title: Cup
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
